title: Career roadmap · SOC Analyst
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on networking, operating systems, cybersecurity fundamentals, SIEM, log analysis, incident response, threat detection, vulnerability management and security operations.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish networking, Linux, programming and security fundamentals; Years 3–4 focus on SIEM, threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, cloud security and security operations.
